desc: Frames whose uniforms are full (AURORA_UNIFORM_BUDGET=4096: room for one copy's push, none for a draw) through the Petal Meadows walk into a battle (hei_01, battle 0) with anaglyph stereo: every EFB copy after the first in a frame finds the uniforms full, so its conversion is left out (no 0-byte uniform binding), and readbacks fail their jobs. The game must keep running to the end of its input with no WebGPU error (the crash paths of a full frame). Screens are mostly black: nothing about the picture is checked. Not checked here: that the stereo compose's failed push is taken so the draw after it isn't dropped (with this budget no draw fits, so a dropped one can't be told from the rest, and no log line marks it).
log_must: AURORA_UNIFORM_BUDGET: a frame's uniforms are held to 4096 of
EFB copy conversion left out: the frame's uniforms are full
capture failed: the frame's buffers are full
